note: Chickasaw County (MS) does not publish a queryable zoning district layer. County GIS is a parcel viewer (chickasawms.maps.arcgis.com) with no zoning service; its org search returns no public items. The county does not zone; the city of Okolona publishes its zoning ordinance only as a PDF, and the City of Houston publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (houston.ms.gov). No ArcGIS REST zoning district layer was found for Okolona, Houston, Van Vleet or Egypt in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches. Only a non-official demo parcel service (Esri Demo_Parcels) carries zoning attributes, and it is not an official source.
